name: agent-fs-write-operations
body:
Code-writer implementer agents delete, move, and copy files inside the surface they own, so a plan task with a deletes / renames / moves verb is implementable.

The capability lives in a suite of filesystem tools — apg_rm, apg_mv, apg_cp — installed by apg init as opencode 2.x plugins, which confine every operation to a path the acting agent is permitted to edit. The acting agent's identity comes from opencode 2.x's tool executor context (`context.agent`), and the per-path decision is opencode's own permission engine's — the mechanism `requirements.constraint.agent-fs-per-path-permission` states. The tool-level grant (deny-by-default) is the callability gate alone; per-path scope comes from the `edit`-action permission assert with the resolved target path as its resource. For a code-writer the granted globs are WORKTREE-ONLY — apg/.worktrees/*/<glob> — and `external_directory` governs a path outside the project worktree (see `requirements.requirement.code-writer-worktree-only-writes`): opencode resolves path-scoped globs against the session workspace root (the main checkout), so the worktree form reaches the worktree, while a root grant reaches main. This is a scoped capability with zero blanket grant: a path outside the agent's granted globs (or revoked by a later deny rule) is refused, a path resolving into the main checkout is refused, and an operation is confined to the project/worktree boundary. A deny rule or a rejection refuses the operation, and an unresolvable acting agent refuses every path (fail-closed).

Scope: rm + mv + cp alone. Product source (opencode-suite/** tool files, opencode-suite/lib/apg.ts, opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md) plus the binary's install registry. External to the repo's own .opencode/agents/**. Plain filesystem operations alone — zero git rm/git mv — and zero change to the binary's node/edge mutation surface.

Acceptance criteria:
- apg init installs the three tools as opencode 2.x plugins under `~/.config/opencode/plugins/`; rust.apg.install's plugin registry carries one entry per tool.
- A generated implementer agent's `permissions` array grants apg_rm/apg_mv/apg_cp scoped to exactly its owned path globs under apg/.worktrees/*/ (worktree-only; zero repo-root variant).
- An fs-op whose source path (and, for mv/cp, destination path) the acting agent's `edit` rules permit succeeds; a path outside the granted globs, or revoked by a later deny rule, is refused; and an out-of-worktree path is governed by `external_directory`.
- The fs tools honour deny rules: a deny rule that is the LAST matching rule refuses the operation, mirroring the agent's `edit` scope. The mechanism is verified by unit/int tests against a faked V2 tool context; the opt-in boundary e2e pins the allow-success and deny-refusal cases against a faked acting-agent scope.
- An fs-op whose path escapes the project/worktree boundary, or resolves into the main checkout, is refused.
- An unresolvable acting agent refuses every path (fail-closed).
- The install-assertion e2e (rust.main_e2e.e2e.suite_installs_node_edge_project_tools_and_retires_spec_invariant) asserts the three tools are embedded and installed under `~/.config/opencode/plugins/`.
